review.posthog_relevance: Adds incremental ingestion and resume capability to the Crisp warehouse connector, allowing warehouse queries to retrieve conversation update timestamps and skip already-read records while resuming after interruption.
review.reason: The chunk implements a bounded, substantive improvement: it adds a metadata column for conversation updates, stores the start time of an incremental run, and implements helper functions and resource configuration for incremental pagination and resume state.
